templates.name: slice-default
templates.description: ps-bash standard slice: server-run ACP implementer -> scope disclosure -> tman build -> tman test (full suite, -m:1) -> headless claude_agent review. Claims the work-kind tags the planners here actually write (bugfix, feature, refactor, ...) and the derived tier tags t1/t2, so a task tagged only by topic still attaches through its size and scope.

steps.name: implement
review

templates.name: high-risk
templates.description: ps-bash escalation tier (security, sync, correctness): the slice gates with a scope REQUIRED. Named high-risk so it shadows the default library's high-risk, whose full-suite step runs another repo's solution.

steps.name: implement
review
